Don't waste your money. I downloaded this app with the hopes of restoring some old photos of my family. However, I was immediately disappointed when I was asked to pay before I could even see a preview of the results.
I understand that some apps require a subscription or one-time payment for access to their features, but I don't think it's fair to not even give users a chance to see if the results are worth the money.

I uploaded a photo of my grandparents, and the app immediately told me that I needed to pay to see the results. I didn't even get to see a preview of the restored photo, so I had no idea if the results would be good or bad.

I think this is a scam, and I would advise anyone considering downloading this app to stay away.
